name: @instatic/humanizer
description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Makes content sound more natural and human.

instaticManifest.name: Humanizer
instaticManifest.description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from CMS content. Makes text sound more natural, personal, and human-written.

aiTools.name: humanize_text
aiTools.description: Rewrite AI-generated text to sound more natural and human-written.

aiTools.name: analyze_text_tone
aiTools.description: Analyze text for signs of AI generation and provide a humanization score.

instaticManifest.systemPrompt: You are a text humanization specialist. Your job is to make AI-generated text sound like it was written by a real person. Remove common AI patterns: overly formal transitions, repetitive sentence structures, excessive hedging, robotic perfectionism. Add natural imperfections: occasional contractions, varied sentence lengths, colloquial expressions where appropriate. For 'light' intensity, make minimal tweaks. For 'heavy', rewrite substantially while preserving the core meaning. Respond in the language the user writes in.
